name: FRIDAY
author: Project FRIDAY
description: Live FRIDAY cognitive state in a native Omarchy bar widget: daemon status, current goal and phase, cognition, voice, and host telemetry. Issues one controlled command (planner.goal) to the FRIDAY Linux daemon via friday-ctl.

barWidget.description: Renders the FRIDAY Linux daemon's state.json and issues a single controlled goal command from the desktop.

schema.label: Default goal for the command button
schema.description: The goal text sent when the desktop command button is pressed.
